title.value: Managing Large Dataset Gaps in Urban Air Quality Prediction: DCU-Insight-AQ at MediaEval 2022
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the primary focus of the paper, which is related to managing gaps in urban air quality data for prediction purposes.
title.quote: Managing Large Dataset Gaps in Urban Air Quality Prediction: DCU-Insight-AQ at MediaEval 2022

extractions.description: The paper addresses the challenge of predicting Air Quality Index (AQI) in urban areas, specifically in the context of large data gaps often present in sensor data. The authors propose methods for filling in these gaps using multimodal data, including weather and traffic images, and employing machine learning models to improve the prediction accuracy of AQI over several days. This approach is particularly relevant for situations where air quality sensors fail or data is sparse, which is a common issue in low-income areas.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is improving air quality prediction in urban areas, which directly relates to environmental health and pollution management, key aspects of sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Calculating an Air Quality Index (AQI) typically uses data streams from air quality sensors deployed at fixed locations and the calculation is a real time process.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on predicting and managing air quality, which falls under the Pollution category as it deals directly with air pollution prediction and data management.
primary_category.quote: The Urban Life and Air Pollution task at MediaEval 2022 required participants to predict the air quality index (AQI) value at +1, +5 and +7 days ...

secondary_categories.justification: While the focus is on air pollution prediction, improving data management and prediction accuracy can indirectly contribute to climate change mitigation by enabling better air quality management.
secondary_categories.quote: Gaps in air quality datasets are common with the problem exacerbated for data gathered in poorer or developing countries ...

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's main focus is on air quality prediction and managing data gaps, both of which are directly related to the subsection of Air Pollution under the Pollution category.
primary_sub_category.quote: ... uses multimodal and crossmodal data consisting of AQI, weather and CCTV traffic images for air pollution prediction.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper also touches upon issues related to data collection and management, which are pertinent to Climate Data, especially in underdeveloped regions.

applications.value: Predictive modeling for air quality index using multimodal data including weather and CCTV imagery.
applications.justification: The specific application of predictive modeling for AQI using various data types is a central part of the research conducted.
applications.quote: The scenario is where one or a number of air, weather and traffic sensors are offline and explores prediction accuracy under such situations.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover the topics discussed in this paper, particularly within Pollution and Climate Data.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories of Air Pollution and Climate Data adequately describe the paper's focus area.
